shellCommands.command: git status --short && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | grep -v '.agents/' | head -100

cat src/App.tsx; echo ----; cat src/main.tsx; echo ----; cat src/vite-env.d.ts; echo ----; cat index.html; echo ----; cat tsconfig.json; echo ----; cat AGENTS.md; echo ----; cat .gitignore; echo ----; ls .agents -R | head -50; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui && rg -n -i 'toast|notif' references/package-routing.md | head -20; echo ----; sed -n 1,60p references/package-routing.md; echo ----; cat rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toast* -d 2>/dev/null; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -ipath '*toast*' | head -30; echo ----; rg -n 'Toaster|useToaster|ToasterProvider|ToasterComponent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | rg -n -i -C 3 'toast|Required setup' | head -120

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $D/components/Toaster/index.d.ts; echo ----; cat $D/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts; echo ----; cat $D/components/Toaster/types.d.ts; echo ----; cat $D/toaster-singleton.d.ts; echo ----; ls $D/components/Toaster/Provider $D/components/Toaster/hooks; cat $D/components/Toaster/Provider/*.d.ts $D/components/Toaster/hooks/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; ls $D/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent; cat $D/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts; echo ----; cat $D/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.js | head -80; echo ----; cat $D/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.js; echo ----; cat $D/toaster-singleton.js; echo ----; grep -rn 'autoHiding' $D/components/Toaster --include=*.js | head; echo ----; cat $D/components/Toaster/constants.js | head -40

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; rg -n 'toaster-singleton|Toaster' $D/index.d.ts; rg -n 'DEFAULT_TIMEOUT' $D/components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.js | head -3; rg -n 'Button' $D/components/index.d.ts | head -3; grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; grep -n 'Button\|view' $D/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; ls $D/components/Button | head; cat $D/components/Button/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $D/index.d.ts | head -20; echo ----; rg -rn 'toaster-singleton' $D --include=*.d.ts | head; echo ----; sed -n 1,20p $D/components/index.d.ts | head -5; echo; rg -n 'Toaster|toaster' $D/components/index.d.ts; echo ----; rg -n '"\./?"|toaster' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $D/components/Toaster/Toaster.js | sed -n 1,60p; echo ----; cat $D/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.js; echo ----; rg -n 'position|bottom|top|left|right' $D/components/Toaster/ToastList/*.css $D/components/Toaster/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls $D/components/Toaster/ToastList

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; sed -n 1,20p $D/components/Toaster/ToastList/ToastList.css; echo ----; sed -n 1,30p $D/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/*.css 2>/dev/null; ls $D/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent; rg -n 'g-toaster' $D/components/Toaster --glob '*.css' | head -5

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $D/components/Button/constants.js | head -20; rg -o -n -- '--g-spacing-4:[^;]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/ 2>/dev/null | head -3; rg -n 'spacing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -8
